title: Two philosophies, one axiom
caption: Apple and Microsoft pay in context switches and platform dependence. Linux pays in expressiveness. Rice's theorem is why the verifier has to be conservative.
alt: Spatial isolation, chosen by Apple and Microsoft, against language-level constraint, chosen by Linux. Both meet Rice's theorem: a verifier cannot decide every interesting property, so it turns some safe programs away.

nodes.title: Rice's theorem
nodes.sub: a verifier has to be conservative, and turns some safe programs away
